weapon.d: Effective against flying foes. Grants Res+3. If foe initiates combat or if foe's HP = 100% at start of combat, grants Atk+6 to unit and inflicts Atk-6 on foe during combat, and also neutralizes penalties to unit's Atk and bonuses to foe's Atk (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.

assist.d: Grants Res+4 to target ally for 1 turn.
Grants Spd/Res+3 to target ally for 1 turn.
Grants Spd/Res+6 to target ally for 1 turn.

a.d: If foe initiates combat, grants Res+2 during combat.
If foe initiates combat, grants Spd/Res+2 during combat.
If foe initiates combat, grants Spd/Res+4 during combat.
If foe initiates combat, grants Spd/Res+6 to unit during combat and inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on foe per attack. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)

c.d: Grants Spd+2 to adjacent allies during combat.
Grants Spd+2 to allies within 2 spaces during combat.
Grants Spd+3 to allies within 2 spaces during combat.
Grants Spd+4 to allies within 2 spaces during combat. If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Spd+4 to unit during combat.
